velocity_method: Edge-replicated adjacent average of staggered u/v, then speed magnitude.

pea_anom.definition: q(z)=g*(rho_bar-rho(z))*z; rho_bar is the mean potential density over 0--min(h,200m). Local PEA contribution, not a cumulative integral.
pea_anom.reference_method: Compute density and local contribution for every daily T/S state, average q by month over 1994--2020, then interpolate month-centre means and subtract at each fixed physical depth.

vertical_method: ROMS Vtransform=2, native sigma levels, per-frame free surface.

anomaly_reference.method: Daily model output minus the 1994-2020 monthly model climatology, linearly interpolated between month centres. No detrending.
anomaly_reference.PEA: Surface: native upper-200 m column PEA anomaly. Sides: depth-local PEA contribution anomaly q(z)=g*(rho_bar-rho(z))*z, over 0--min(h,200m), on fixed 5 m display depths. The layer mean of q is PEA; q is not cumulative. Density and q are computed for each daily T/S state before 1994--2020 monthly averaging. Side and surface scales are separate.
